script_text: Saturn squares your Sun this week, Leo — brace for raw tension between ambition and exhaustion demanding strategic patience. Early week, Mercury conjunct Jupiter in your 3rd House sharpens communication, making Tuesday your strongest day for negotiations. Monday suffers because Mars opposes Saturn, draining your fire element confidence and creating friction in relationships. Mid-week turning point, Venus enters your 5th House on Wednesday, igniting romance and creative inspiration after the grind. Late week Thursday through Sunday, the Sun advances toward your 10th House career sector. A Jupiter trine to your natal Sun reveals a financial opportunity — possibly a promotion or an unexpected income. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, supercharging love and creative self-expression. Monday is your worst day because the Mars-Saturn opposition drains confidence and creates frustrating delays. Focus on one bold career move this week. Follow for daily updates.
